overall_summary: The channel shows early traction with family and relationship dynamics. One clear outlier ('or5gtaBpRVY' with 1619 views) focused on husband-wife dynamics, while mother and relationship checking-in videos ('OfHrAp3r1G8', 'rl_ycNbXZ_g') performed moderately better than sibling-specific or generic motivational content. Sample size is small, so confidence is moderate with a need for continued testing around close relationships.

winning_patterns.evidence: Wife emotional video reached 1,619 views, significantly outperforming other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more relatable domestic and romantic relationship scenarios.

winning_patterns.evidence: Mother asking 'khana khaya?' (224 views) and calling a loved one (288 views) performed well above the channel average.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, routine inquiries as hook foundations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional videos received very low views (17 and 125 views respectively).
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize sibling-focused content for now in favor of broader relationship themes.
